amendments.also: A HARNESS/DEVICE HEALTH stop was added: if the UNSPLICED carrier itself fails to run after 5 consecutive full 40 s recovery cycles the arm stops, because every later case would be a 40-second-per-case artefact rather than an observation. This is explicitly NOT a hang budget -- hangs still never stop anything, and the full range is still dispatched.
amendments.fix: ONE reader thread per child, tagged with the process it came from, so lines from a dead child are discarded instead of handed to the wrong request; and a malformed response recorded as a MEASUREMENT FAILURE (status MALFORMED) with the raw lines kept -- NEVER as a hang. A malformed response is not an observation and must not be scored as one.
amendments.hardware_fact_recorded_here: The pre-registered falsifier is NOT a hang. Clearing byte0 bit 2 of the get_sr anchor (so the four bytes are no longer a get_sr) runs clean on G17P: STATUS OK, GPUTIME_NS 5000, integrity sentinel written, and the read-back collapses to the SR_BIAS-only silent-zero pattern. Verified by hand against the runner outside the harness. Every `hang` in work/pilot02..05 was a harness artefact; this experiment has caused no GPU reset at any point.

amendments.what: Adds harness/saferunner.py (leak-free persistent-runner subclasses + a defensive response parser), harness/fakerunner.py (a no-device protocol stub) and selftest gate G9; run.py now uses the subclasses, captures a traceback on any runner exception, and carries a HARNESS/DEVICE HEALTH stop distinct from a hang budget.
amendments.why: DIAGNOSIS, NOT REPAIR, found by the pilots (work/pilot01..05) BEFORE any gated dispatch. Both shared drivers -- tools/agxtest/persistrun.py and the rsdrv.py render driver -- start a FRESH reader thread per line and ABANDON it on timeout, and that thread re-resolves self.proc at EXECUTION time. After the first watchdog timeout the abandoned thread wakes on the REPLACEMENT child's stdout and races the foreground reader; responses come back truncated ('OUT 0 ' with the hex missing) and the shared parser raises ValueError: not enough values to unpack, killing the run. In work/pilot02..05 ONE benign case poisoned every later request including the unspliced health check, and three consecutive cases were recorded `hang` with restarts=99 -- ALL FALSE. This experiment deliberately has no hang budget, so hangs are expected and this defect would have manufactured a cascade of artefacts. It is the sibling of DEF-0153-2 (the EOF spin) in the same file.
amendments.why_this_is_not_a_post_hoc_repair: The freeze exists to stop the harness being edited AFTER data is seen. At the moment of this amendment raw/ is EMPTY: zero gated dispatches have occurred, so no observation exists that these edits could have been fitted to. Everything run so far lives in work/ under pilot ids and is retained, never reused.

amendments.why: Self-caught before any gated dispatch, by re-reading the classifier against the carriers. `is_zeroish` decides the `silent_zero` outcome, and it was written as 'the observation is 0'. That is WRONG on the fragment [[position]] carrier: a zero SR read still lands as the pixel-centre offset C, not as 0.0, so every fragment silent zero -- the single most important outcome class on this ISA, where a wrong field value usually yields a silent zero rather than a fault -- would have been misclassified as `wrong_value`. On the vertex carrier a zero read interpolates to 0 at every corner, so 0.0 is correct there and is kept.

amendments.why: SUBAGENT_BRIEF, updated 2026-08-30: *do not chain a state-changing step behind `&&` and assume it ran.* EXP-0179's `sync.sh push` returned non-zero inside a chained command and a gated pass executed against the STALE pre-amendment harness -- 6 cases instead of 8, remote hashes not matching local -- burning a run id; the orchestrator hit the same shape hours earlier with a silently skipped PROVENANCE.md append. amendments.applied_incompletely_first_time: HONEST DISCLOSURE. The `nb` -> `out_nbytes` rename was applied to the ASSIGNMENT but not to the one USE, which spans two lines and so did not match the literal I replaced on. work/pilot06 caught it immediately -- `NameError: name 'nb' is not defined` on the very first request, recorded as `RUNNER_EXCEPTION` -> outcome `fault` on the BASELINE, and the arm aborted with `arm_error: baseline did not run` before a single case was dispatched. That is the behaviour the design wants: a broken harness fails LOUDLY on the baseline instead of quietly producing 570 inertness readings. Fixed, re-pushed, re-verified as a separate step, and re-piloted before the gated pair. The point generalises: it was the traceback in the runner-exception handler -- added an hour earlier -- that named the fault in one line both times.
amendments.generalisation: TWO INDEPENDENT DEFECTS CAN SHARE ONE SIGNATURE, and having just fixed a cascade-shaped defect makes the next cascade-shaped defect HARDER to see. Check the exception's identity -- text, call site, stack -- not its shape.
amendments.run_ids: g17p_20260830_run01 is BURNED: retained exactly as it landed, never topped up, deleted or reused. The gated pair is g17p_20260830_run03 / run04. run02 was never dispatched and is also not reused, so no id is ambiguous.
amendments.the_instrument_that_earned_its_keep: `measurement_failed` was added hours earlier for a different reason and paid for itself before measuring anything: because a malformed runner response was already a non-observation rather than a `hang` or a `fault`, this harness bug could never have entered a verdict as an inertness reading on get_sr.sr_sel. Under the pre-amendment classifier it would have been recorded as `fault` -- a harness bug promoted to a hardware claim.

amendments.victims: Orchestrator direction: an `invalid_run` victim (kIOGPUCommandBufferCallbackErrorInnocentVictim / 'Discarded (victim of GPU error/recovery)' / 'Ignored (for causing prior/excessive GPU errors)') is a statement about the MACHINE, never about our bytes -- a device reset discards in-flight command buffers in every context. Victims now join measurement_failed in NON_OBSERVATIONS: excluded from the agreement computation AND from values_dispatched/distinct_bytes, with the OS fault-class string kept in `victim` and reported per arm by analysis/answers.py. Relevant now that EXP-0180's LEN and DSTNIB arms may dispatch concurrently.
amendments.what: Fixes a CLOSURE-SHADOWING defect in harness/run.py that destroyed the first gated attempt; adds selftest gate G10 to catch the defect CLASS mechanically; treats an `invalid_run` victim as a NON-OBSERVATION alongside `measurement_failed`; makes harness/verify_remote.py upstreamable.
amendments.why: raw/g17p_20260830_run01 is DEFECTIVE and RETAINED (see DEFECTIVE-run01.md). The compute arm bound its read-back SIZE as `nb` and the `raw_case` closure read it; the falsifier block later rebound `nb` to a bytearray in the SAME enclosing scope. A closure resolves a free variable at CALL time, so from the falsifier onward every request asked for a read-back of a bytearray bytes and raised inside the request builder. It presented as a HANG CASCADE -- byte-for-byte the signature of the shared-driver defect fixed minutes earlier -- which is why four pilots did not separate the two. The exception TEXT was the tell and changed from `not enough values to unpack` to `%d format: a number is required, not bytearray`; adding traceback.format_exc() to the handler named the call site on the first run that hit it.

procedure.design_cross_check_applied: EXP-0179's self-reported defect -- its own layout omitted the `pop_reconverge` that its own EARLIER arm had already MEASURED to be required, which would have produced the wrong hardware claim 'depth-2 calls fault' looking perfectly clean -- was applied as a checklist to this experiment's carriers. Two prior measured requirements bear on them and BOTH are honoured: (a) EXP-0086's later-read discipline, which every get_sr carrier satisfies via a separate later consumer and a third separate store; and (b) EXP-0130/EXP-0117's finding that a PURE PASSTHROUGH fragment shape is ELIDED ENTIRELY -- 16 bytes containing neither opcode -- which is why every tilebuffer carrier here combines the read with genuinely non-foldable ALU against a runtime uniform rather than returning `dst`.

outcome_enum_documented_extensions.invalid_run: collateral damage from another context ('Discarded (victim...)' / 'Ignored (for causing prior...)') after 5 in-place retries and a restart cycle. NOT evidence about the encoding. Established by EXP-0147.
outcome_enum_documented_extensions.measurement_failed: DEF-0178-1. The runner returned a MALFORMED or unparseable response (a truncated OUT line, or an exception in the response parser). This is NOT AN OBSERVATION: it says nothing about the encoding, and it must not be scored as a hang OR as a fault. The raw response lines are kept on the record (`raw_lines`). The promotion gate REMOVES these values from the agreement computation -- counting them as agreement would inflate the percentage, counting them as disagreement would penalise the field for a harness problem -- and REFUSES any field whose measurement failures exceed 1% of its dispatched values, because its null result would be sitting on top of a measurement problem. analysis/answers.py reports the count per arm.
outcome_enum_documented_extensions.no_dispatch: compute: same, via the integrity sentinel buffer.
outcome_enum_documented_extensions.no_draw: render: the runner returned OK but every pixel still holds the CLEAR colour, so nothing was drawn. Confirmed twice with a healthy device in between. Established by EXP-0147/EXP-0141.
outcome_enum_documented_extensions.not_written: compute: the sentinel proves the dispatch RAN but the read-back is still 0xDEADBEEF poison, i.e. our store did not land. A different fact from 'the store wrote 0'. Motivated by EXP-0169's DSTORE finding that a device_store through an unbound slot is SILENTLY DROPPED with no fault and no diagnostic -- absence of a fault proves nothing.

safety.why: FIELD-SWEEP-PROTOCOL 3(c): a per-field budget cannot characterise a CONTIGUOUS hazard, it guarantees the region is never mapped (frag_color_pack.dst's wall at 0xC0 was walked into by three experiments and seen by none; EXP-0168's 'defer the known-bad values' fix only moved the wall twice). Full-range dispatch maps it INSIDE the gated run, which is how EXP-0169's DSTORE arm pinned device_store.index_reg ((v & 0x60)==0x60) and extmode (v >= 0xFC) exactly. EXP-0168 showed the device survives such a region: 64 hangs, no reset, no wedge, no macvdmtool.
